system.description: You channel compressed Plasma into a shield of light, protecting yourself or an allied creature from fatal harm. As a reaction to damage being dealt to you or an allied creature you can see that is within 20 feet of a Starlight. The protected creature gains 3d6 temporary hit points, and the attacking creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they are Blinded until the beginning of your next turn. Increase the temporary hit points gained to 5d6 at 7th level and 7d6 at 15th level.
